name: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo

lineage.how_derived: accelerated checkpoint with a saved 8-step schedule, CFG=1 by default (card; the distillation method is not named)

purpose: Accelerated checkpoint of Qwen-Image-2.1 for text-to-image generation and image editing with 8 denoising steps, same 7B visual generation architecture (card).

license.name: Qwen Research License Agreement (release date 2026-09-20)
license.notes: LICENSE of this repo read: grant is FOR NON-COMMERCIAL PURPOSES ONLY and Non-Commercial means for research or evaluation purposes only; same text as read for Qwen-Image-2.1. The card languages are not listed in the header; en and zh are taken from the card's prompt examples and the base record. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: single-stream diffusion transformer, dense (same 7B visual generation architecture as Qwen-Image-2.1), text encoder in the same repo
architecture.why_this_design: Turbo: 8 steps instead of the base schedule, prefix KV caching reuses the text and reference-image context across denoising steps (card).

variants.format: diffusers BF16 (transformer + text encoder 17.5 GB + VAE 0.68 GB)

variants.notes: Q8_0 7.64 GB, Q2_K 2.47 GB, F16 14.23 GB; text encoder is separate; 1.8M downloads on the HF API

pc-12gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q5_K_M with offloaded text encoder

other: Diffusers (QwenImage21Pipeline, needs a Diffusers version with pipeline-configured sigmas, PR 14950)
GGUF runtimes for diffusion models (not tested by us)
engine_support.notes: Card: the saved 8-step schedule is loaded automatically; other schedules not evaluated.

strengths: 8 steps at CFG 1 means roughly one fifth of the base model's 40-step compute (arithmetic from the stated step counts, not a measurement)
Poster and text-heavy layouts shown in card examples; image editing supported
weaknesses: No benchmark numbers on the card; quality loss against the base model unmeasured by us

Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo-PE does not appear to exist: HF API and raw README return 401 and the repo is missing from the Qwen author listing by creation date (the existing prompt rewriters are Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I and PE-I2I, see record qwen-image-2.1-pe)
best_for: fast local text-to-image and editing for non-commercial work
soft.maturity: Alibaba Qwen; 29k downloads for the original and 1.8M for the unsloth GGUF on the HF API 2026-11-19.

tona_fit.reason: Quality and speed make it a good local image model (same architecture as qwen-image-2.1, Qwen's own Turbo checkpoint). Compare with z-image-turbo, moss-image-sft and flux3-image-klein on our own prompts before choosing the default.

open_questions: Quality versus the 40-step base model (arena Elo or GenEval not published on the card)

Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo-PE (prompt-enhancer variant): repo not accessible (401 on API and raw, absent from the author listing, 2026-11-19), probably not existing; the PE-T2I and PE-I2I rewriters (9B, Qwen Research License) are documented for Qwen-Image-2.1, whether they are meant for the Turbo model is not stated on the Turbo card
